The '''Mouth of the Ancestors''' was a position on the [[Royal Court]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. The Mouth of History cited precedent from the rule of previous [[Rajah]]s, and the bearing that they had on the current issue laid before the Rajah.
